findings.evidence: The report omits the leading backslash before operatorname. The repository's markdownToHtml/KaTeX path accepts the string but renders operatorname and wrap as separate italic variables, so the displayed definition is mathematically and visually wrong rather than merely stylistically different.
findings.action: Replace +operatorname{wrap}(...) with +\operatorname{wrap}\!(...) and rerun the report parser/build check. Recompute the report SHA-256 and rerun this review because the current binding will become stale.
